entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Agent' to speak with a representative.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-921104. Can you process that for me?
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They're a pair of cycling shoes. They're giving me blisters. I've tried moving the cleats around, wearing different socks, nothing works. I just need a refund.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up that order... VF-921104... I see it here. It looks like the delivery was 38 days ago.
Right. So, can I return them or not?
Yes, absolutely. For our cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return policy. You are well within that window.
Great. So what's the next step?

I've just approved the return on my end and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any carrier location. Once we receive the item, we'll issue your full refund.
Okay, perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
